moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-md3a, written here): cubic-bezier(.3, 0, 1, 1), 200 ms (site motion_ms), for exits: accelerates to the very end and disappears. Writable now as custom(M0,0 C .3,0 1,1 1,1); proposed alias md3.accelerate. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.2 s) · ease (custom .3,0,1,1).
